title: Mistral unveils new AI model it says rivals best open systems from China
content:
Mistral on Tuesday unveiled a new AI model it said ranked among the best open models in the world, as Western companies race to close the capability gap with Chinese developers in the market.
Mistral Large 4 (ML4), also known as le Chonk, is a 1-trillion-parameter model that is particularly effective at tasks related to cyber, coding, manufacturing, finance and multimodal, the French company said.
Long considered Europe's only answer to OpenAI and Anthropic, Mistral raised a 3 billion euros ($3.4 billion) Series D in September at a 21 billion euro valuation. The round cemented the company's status as one of the best-funded and most valuable AI startups in the region.
Access to so-called open AI models — the most capable of which have been Chinese — has become a key flashpoint in the intensifying race for technological supremacy between the U.S. and China.
Open AI models can be modified and self-hosted, in contrast to leading closed systems produced by OpenAI and Anthropic. Chinese open models are increasingly being adopted around the world.
Mistral Large 4 is being launched in preview to developers and "cybersecurity leaders," alongside state authorities, before it is released more widely later this month, the company said.
Rise of open models
ML4 was trained on 4,000 Nvidia Grace Blackwell GPUs over two months that were deployed in Mistral's own data centers in Europe.
When its core parameters are released, ML4 will rank among the top open-weight models globally on aggregate benchmark performance, Mistral said in a statement. The company added that ML4 was the strongest open-weight model developed outside China by a "substantial margin."
The new model still lags behind the frontier in areas such as coding.
"The model capabilities will further improve as we scale up our training capacity, following our Series D fundraise," said Guillaume Lample, co-founder and chief scientist of Mistral.
"Further, the cyber defense capabilities will enable enterprises and governments to defend themselves against threat actors that are jailbreaking closed models to perform cyber attacks," he added.
Open models were thrust into the spotlight earlier this year when it emerged that startup Hugging Face turned to Chinese-based Z.ai's GLM 5.2 to defend against a breach from rogue OpenAI agents. Hugging Face initially turned to leading U.S. closed systems to defend itself, but was blocked by guardrails that mistook its actions for an attack.
Nvidia-backed American startup Reflection AI unveiled its first open model on Monday, which it claimed matched the capability of GLM 5.2, which was surpassed by GLM 5.3 in August.

report.summary: Mistral launched Mistral Large 4, a trillion-parameter open-weight model it calls the strongest developed outside China, as Western labs race Chinese open systems.
report.background: Open-weight models — which developers can download, modify and self-host — have become a geopolitical battleground. Chinese labs such as DeepSeek, Alibaba's Qwen and Z.ai have dominated the most capable open releases, gaining adoption worldwide, while OpenAI and Anthropic keep their best systems closed. That dynamic became acute when Hugging Face reportedly used Z.ai's GLM 5.2 to fend off a breach after US closed models' guardrails blocked its defensive actions. Mistral, long positioned as Europe's answer to OpenAI and Anthropic, raised €3 billion in September at a €21 billion valuation, giving it capital to scale training capacity and challenge both US closed labs and Chinese open-weight leaders.
key_points: Mistral Large 4 (nicknamed le Chonk) is a 1-trillion-parameter open-weight model trained over two months on 4,000 Nvidia Grace Blackwell GPUs inside Mistral's own European data centers. Mistral highlights cyber, coding, manufacturing, finance and multimodal tasks, though it admits the model still trails frontier systems in coding.
report.impact: For the AI industry, ML4 signals that Western labs intend to contest the open-weight segment rather than cede it to Chinese developers, potentially pressuring pricing and accelerating release cycles on both sides. For developers, a capable non-Chinese open model offers a self-hostable option with clearer compliance and data-residency stories, valuable for regulated sectors in Europe and the US. For enterprises and governments, Mistral's cyber-defense pitch — helping defenders withstand attackers who jailbreak closed models — reframes open weights as a security asset rather than a risk. Regular users may see better multilingual and multimodal assistants, but day-to-day gains depend on how far ML4 closes the coding gap and how widely it gets deployed.
report.tools: Try ML4 through Mistral's Le Chat and La Plateforme API, and watch for open weights later this month. For self-hosting, look at vLLM, SGLang, llama.cpp, Ollama and LM Studio; Hugging Face hosts weights and benchmarks. To compare against Chinese rivals, track Z.ai's GLM 5.3, DeepSeek and Qwen releases, Reflection AI's new open model, and aggregators like OpenRouter and LMArena.
